name: acmecore__member__get_savings_balance_and_shares
description: Look Up Member Savings Balance and Share List. Read-only and safe to retry. Returns: savings_balance (money), shares (table). Business outcomes: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: No member exists with this member number. Guidance: Ask the user to double-check the member number. Safe to retry with a corrected number. INPUT_REJECTED_BY_APP: The application rejected the member number format. Guidance: Correct the member number (digits only) and retry. ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED: The member record is restricted (e.g. an employee account) for this operator. Guidance: Retrying will not help; route the request to staff with supervisor access. OUTPUT_NOT_PRESENT: The record has no entry for a requested value (no row with the recorded key). Guidance: Tell the user the record has no such entry. This is an answer, not an error.

member_number.description: The member number used to look up the member record in AcmeCore Format: ^[0-9]{5}$.

name: acmecore__share__open_share_account
description: Open New Share Account for Member. It COMMITS a change and needs a human approval. Returns: confirmation_number (identifier), share_id (identifier). Business outcomes: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: No member exists with this member number. Guidance: Ask the user to double-check the member number. Safe to retry with a corrected number. INPUT_REJECTED_BY_APP: The application rejected the member number format. Guidance: Correct the member number (digits only) and retry. ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED: The member record is restricted (e.g. an employee account) for this operator. Guidance: Retrying will not help; route the request to staff with supervisor access. INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The funding share does not have enough available balance. Guidance: Tell the user the available balance is too low; retry with a smaller amount. INVALID_AMOUNT: The application rejected the deposit amount. Guidance: Correct the amount (positive, at most two decimals) and retry. INVALID_NICKNAME: The nickname contains characters the application does not accept. Guidance: Use letters, numbers and spaces only (max 20) and retry. REQUEST_ALREADY_PROCESSED: The application refused a repeated submission. Guidance: Do not retry. Check the member's shares first; the earlier submission may have succeeded. APPROVAL_DENIED: A human operator declined the commit step; nothing was committed. Guidance: Tell the user staff declined the request. Do not retry without new instructions.

member_number.description: Member number of the account holder for whom the share is opened Format: ^[0-9]{5}$.

initial_deposit.description: Initial deposit amount funding the new share

nickname.description: Member-facing nickname/label for the new share
